objective: Diagnose whether completed causal B history carries action-relative information beyond action-only and commissioning context in the exposed six-context OUT0 recipe library
scope: OFFLINE_CONTEXTUAL_LIBRARY_FIT; neither fresh on-policy nor actual continuous Trial adaptation
input_history: V7_COMPLETE_B_HISTORY8_DATASET.json; six groups EARLYN01/EARLYH01/EARLYL01/CFACTORH01/CFACTORL01/HOLDSS03; all exposed development
input_outcomes: main-agent frozen HISTORICAL_RECIPE_DATASET_V2.json, exact complete underlying recipe bindings required before fit
no_missing_label_rule: Every context must contain complete original JF/JM/qualification for each requested menu action; absent rows remain absent and are not filled or inferred
motion_missing_rule: Missing original margin head omitted with explicit status; never fill zero. Original complete qualification remains authoritative for offline realized evaluation.

models.design: action one-hot including B; no context
action one-hot plus normalized history8; context main effects shared across actions
action one-hot plus normalized history8 plus explicit history8 x nonbaseline-action one-hot
same frozen HISTORY_INTERACTION weights; infer current context as training-fold mean history8, no current complete B history supplied
independent comparator, same recipe heads and fold-local preprocessing with main-agent allowlisted commissioned25

fit: regularized least squares per head, intercept unpenalized and fixed ridge=1; no hyperparameter search or calibration claim
folds: 6 leave-one-parent-context-out development folds plus all-exposed fit; each context's actions kept together
preprocessing: training-context mean/std fitted inside each fold; scale <1e-9 becomes 1; exact named order frozen; no source split mixing
selection: predicted qualification>=0.5, B always admissible as fallback; select minimum predicted paired JF among eligible. JF objective separate from JM/motion, no weighted objective. Also report unconstrained cost ranking to distinguish information from eligibility gates.
uncertainty_scope: No 6-context CV error is a certified confidence bound. No model-safe claim.
required_outputs: all fitted weights and exact feature names
per-fold predicted/selected tag and original realized qualification/JF/JM/motion
all bad predictions and all failures retained
promotion_gate: No physical promotion without main-agent review of frozen outputs, different fresh context and same-menu original qualification evaluation
extension_rule: If local timeout is insufficient, terminate preserving partial; further batch needs a separately recorded main-agent approval rather than silently extending
